review_summary.executive_summary: Automated Code Review for 'snippet_20261122_075622.py' (Python). Overall Code Health Score: 70.0/100 (Grade C). Identified 2 finding(s): 1 Critical, 1 High, 0 Medium, 0 Low. Verdict: Changes Requested.

critical.title: OS Command Injection via Shell Execution
critical.description: Execution of operating system shell commands using os.system() or subprocess with shell=True. If user-controlled input reaches the command string, arbitrary system commands can be executed.
critical.potential_impact: Attackers can chain shell metacharacters (;, |, &&, `) to execute arbitrary commands with application privileges, leading to full server compromise.
critical.suggested_remediation: Pass command arguments as a list of strings and set shell=False, or use native Python libraries.

high.title: Use of Broken Cryptographic Algorithm
high.description: Usage of obsolete or vulnerable cryptographic algorithms (MD5, SHA-1, or ECB mode). These algorithms suffer from collision attacks and lack integrity verification.
high.potential_impact: MD5 and SHA-1 collisions are trivial to generate. Passwords hashed with MD5 can be cracked in seconds.
high.suggested_remediation: Use SHA-256/SHA-512 for data integrity, bcrypt/Argon2 for passwords, and AES-GCM for encryption.

recommendations_for_improvement.reason: Shell execution permits arbitrary host system takeover via untrusted input.
recommendations_for_improvement.suggested_action: Use safe process execution with argument vectors and shell=False.

recommendations_for_improvement.reason: Legacy algorithms (MD5, DES, ECB) suffer known collision and predictability attacks.
recommendations_for_improvement.suggested_action: Use SHA-256 for data verification and AES-GCM or bcrypt for passwords.

final_review_summary: Review concluded with status Changes Requested. The target artifact contains 1 critical and 1 high severity security issues requiring immediate remediation.
